description: This source file contains integration tests for client status transitions in the Fineract platform, including reject, undo reject, withdrawal, undo withdrawal, and validation scenarios.

classes.name: ClientUndoRejectAndWithdrawalIntegrationTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying client status change behaviors such as reject, undo reject, withdrawal, undo withdrawal, and related date validations in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured settings, configures request and response specifications, and sets up the ClientHelper before each test.

methods.name: clientUndoRejectIntegrationTest
methods.description: Tests the flow of creating a client, rejecting, and then undoing the rejection, verifying each status at each step.

methods.name: testClientUndoRejectWithDateBeforeRejectDate
methods.description: Verifies that undo reject operation with a date before the rejection date results in an error.

methods.name: testClientUndoRejectWithoutReject
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to undo rejection on a client that hasn't been rejected results in a specific error.

methods.name: testClientUndoRejectWithFutureDate
methods.description: Verifies that undo reject operation with a future date is rejected.

methods.name: clientUndoWithDrawnIntegrationTest
methods.description: Tests the flow of creating a client, withdrawing, and then undoing withdrawal, verifying statuses.

methods.name: testClientUndoWithDrawnWithDateBeforeWithdrawal
methods.description: Verifies that undo withdrawal with a date before the withdrawal date results in an error.

methods.name: testClientUndoWithDrawnWithoutWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks that attempting to undo withdrawal on a non-withdrawn client results in an error.

methods.name: testClientUndoWithDrawnWithFutureDate
methods.description: Verifies that undo withdrawal with a future date is rejected.

methods.name: testValidateReopenedDate
methods.description: Checks that reopening a client account with an invalid date (after withdrawal) raises an error.

methods.name: testReopenedDate
methods.description: Verifies that after withdrawal and undo, activating a client with a different date proceeds successfully.
